svg.title: Гиперэкстензия с блином — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. 45 degree back-extension bench with the athlete's ankles securely fixed in visible rollers and front upper thighs supported by a pad, hips free above pad. Hold ONE FLAT ROUND WEIGHT PLATE with center hole directly against chest using both hands, visible at three-quarter side angle. LEFT: torso flexed down from hips, plate still held against chest. RIGHT: torso raised until shoulders, hips and ankles line up diagonally, plate still visibly against chest, no lumbar overextension. Both feet and all rollers remain fixed. Clear flat circular disc with center hole, never a dumbbell. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
